# arcane_api_resource (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cluster scoped api resource
data "arcane_api_resources" "ns" {
  api_version = "v1"
  kind        = "Namespace"
  name        = "default"
}

# Namespaced scoped api resource
data "arcane_api_resources" "role" {
  api_version = "apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1"
  kind        = "Role"
  name        = "read-only"
  namespace   = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_version` (String) API version of the resource (e.g., 'v1' or 'apps/v1')
- `kind` (String) Kind of the resource (e.g., 'ConfigMap', 'Deployment')
- `name` (String) Name of the resource

### Optional

- `kind_plural` (String) Plural API resource name, converted to lowercase. Defaults to the lowercase kind with 's' appended.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the resource (required for namespaced resources)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) API path of the resource
- `object` (String) Resource object returned by the API server

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
